request.business_problem: Our 6-person support team reads every ticket by hand to decide what it is and who should handle it, and replies are inconsistent in tone.
request.tasks: Sort each customer ticket into billing, shipping, product defect, returns or other; rate urgency; draft a reply in our friendly, plain tone that a human reviews before sending.
request.required_output: Category, urgency (low/normal/high/urgent), one-line summary, and a draft reply of under 120 words.
request.examples:
Ticket: 'My tent arrived with a snapped pole and the trip is Saturday. Order NW-48213.' -> shipping/defect, urgent.
Ticket: 'Can I change the address on order NW-48220?' -> shipping, normal.

smoke.prompt: Triage this support ticket: 'Hi, I was charged twice for order NW-51002 and I need the extra charge refunded today, I am travelling tomorrow.'
